result.note: The visit produced no signed outcome, so the question tests only the negotiators and the stated aim of an interim deal under the India-US BTA.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer visited New Delhi for trade negotiations with India. Consider the following statements:
items: Greer held talks with India's Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal.
The visit was framed as a step towards finalising an interim agreement, consistent with a joint statement of 7 February 2026.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both statements are correct. Greer held multiple rounds of talks with Piyush Goyal from 22 to 24 June 2026, and both sides cast the interim deal as a milestone towards a comprehensive Bilateral Trade Agreement. The talks covered market access, digital trade, supply chain resilience and the reduction of non-tariff barriers.
questions.source: The visit was framed as a step towards finalising an interim agreement, consistent with the joint statement of 7 February, that both sides cast as a milestone towards a comprehensive BTA delivering tangible benefits for businesses, farmers, workers, and consumers in both countries.
